summary: Amarc Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (press release) announcing a preliminary ~$15 million 2026 exploration budget for the JOY Copper-Gold District in British Columbia, fully funded by Freeport-McMoRan through the AML joint venture. Freeport, having earned 60% in AML, is earning an additional 10% by investing $75 million. Amarc, the primary contractor, plans a 70-person camp, three drill rigs, and two helicopters starting June 2026. The program focuses on step-out drilling at the AuRORA deposit, drilling at TWINS, and testing two porphyry targets. This purely operational update involves no merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation category.
